nativeSourceAudit.method: Pinned local source/bytecode inspection; bounded bytecode-as-data oracle with explicit allocation/cache boundaries; no Minecraft or original mod class loading
geometry: Block.box divides six coordinates by 16; only exact lower half admitted
Old bounds normalize inversions; target factory rejects them
Old findBits floor/fixed tolerance differs from target round/scaled tolerance
Exact box requests filled lower cell of a 1x2x1 grid in both audited factory paths
Target solidity threshold uses average extent 5/6, not box volume; conditional on supplied cache facts
boundaries: BitSet allocation/fill operations are recorded, not native cache/game execution
Bounds/isEmpty facts are modeled explicitly for calculateSolid; native defaults need separate QA
Unknown reached calls/opcodes and loops beyond the bound fail

loot.format: one minecraft:block table, one pool, numeric rolls 1, one local item, survives_explosion only
loot.defaults: Omitted bonus_rolls=0, weight=1, quality=0 in both inspected parsers
semanticDifferences: Target TNT explosion decay defaults false
Target distinguishes DESTROY from DESTROY_WITH_DECAY for radius context
RNG/context construction differs; no identical random-outcome claim

negativeScope: Geometry bounds, numeric types, negative zero, NaN/infinity, dynamic/context-dependent bodies and opcodes
